title: Wire every New World block into Daniel Tyack's site to real Space rows
detail:
Each function block (events, booking, reviews, plans, shop, team, library, locations, contact, letter, FAQ) bound to the Space's real rows exactly as NetworkEvents/SpaceBooking/SpaceReviews are; a function the kit has off renders nothing; empty states present.

Closed 2026-11-09: the plans, shop and posts blocks read the Space's memberships, shop and library (lib/sites/new-world-live.ts, attached under metadata.space.newWorld by the site render when the page draws a New World block); the team, groups and where-to-find-us blocks read the Space team, circles and business info off the same bag the Space content blocks use; a function the Space has switched off renders nothing, a function with no rows keeps its empty state, the owner's rows draw when no bag is attached (the editor canvas). The book page draws nothing when booking is off and no ways in are written. Posts bind to the library of journeys and practices: a Space has no posts entity of its own (the wall block is LIVE-2108).
